label: Economic output
definition: Emirate GDP at constant prices as a driver of energy water and emissions
citation: EAD 2021, Greenhouse Gas Inventory and Projections for Abu Dhabi Emirate (GHG correlation 0.87 with GDP, oil and gas 35 % of GDP in 2015)

label: Livestock population
definition: Head of camels sheep goats and cattle on farms
citation: EAD 2018, Abu Dhabi Air Emissions Inventory (livestock 2,255 t NMVOC and 727 t PM10 in 2015, a relatively important source of PM and NMVOC)

label: Coastal land reclamation
definition: Area of sea and intertidal zone converted to built land
citation: Dahy 2025, Tracing the Heat (reclamation areas warming +2.93 degC per year summer and +4.20 degC per year winter, loss of water bodies from 600 to 300 km2 per Ramadan 2025)

label: Fugitive service station VOC
definition: Evaporative NMVOC from fuel storage and refuelling at service stations
citation: EAD 2018, Abu Dhabi Air Emissions Inventory (193 t NMVOC in 2015 as a separate sector)
